check_help: An advisory assessment of the highlighted crop, without confirming animal presence.
check_running: Checking this crop. Bird work takes priority.
check_uncertain: The model is uncertain. Review the photo yourself.
check_unavailable: Photo check unavailable. Review the photo yourself.
check_advisory: This photo only. Confirm or dismiss it yourself; no review decision has been saved.
check_scores: Bird {bird} · Non-human mammal {mammal} · Human {human} · Blank {blank} · Other {other}
check_changed: The photo check does not match the displayed photo. Refresh before trying again.
save_error: Could not save your review. Try again.
saved_crop_only: Saved animal crop. The original photo is unavailable.
saved_crop_count: Saved animal crops: {count} / {limit}. Full photos keep their separate expiry.
title: Garden animals
labels_help: Comma-separated animal labels tracked by Frigate, for example cat, dog or squirrel. Birds, people and vehicles are excluded; add chickens and other birds you keep under Domestic birds you keep.
model_status_unavailable: Model status unavailable. Refresh to try again.
catalogue_unavailable: Garden species data is unavailable. Check the application startup diagnostics.
country_missing: Set a recognised country or ISO code in Settings → Location
group_only: Animal group only; species is unresolved.
identification_unknown: No reliable identification. Leave this animal unidentified or request a new suggestion.
whole_image: Whole image with model border trim
motion_camera_help: Optional CPU scans of retained motion footage. Needs the motion detector under Garden models; bird detection keeps its current settings.
motion_limits: CPU only · At least {seconds}s between scans · Up to {limit} photos · {days}-day photo retention
presence_box: Box: MegaDetector Cedar candidate. Check the photo before confirming.
photo_restore_unavailable: Photo unavailable. It cannot return to review.
motion_coverage: Up to {limit} short windows queued per camera from the last {minutes} minutes. Birds and camera pressure pause collection; brief visits can be missed.
motion_queue: {camera}: {count, plural, one {# window waiting} other {# windows waiting}} when checked at {time}. More may be available at the queue limit.
batch_dismissed: {count, plural, one {# photo dismissed.} other {# photos dismissed.}}
batch_restored: {count, plural, one {# photo returned to review.} other {# photos returned to review.}}
batch_skipped: {count, plural, one {# photo was unchanged because its review or availability changed.} other {# photos were unchanged because their review or availability changed.}}
batch_undo_help: Undo is available while photos remain. Dismissed photos may make room for new captures.
group_count: {count, plural, one {# photo around the same position} other {# photos around the same position}}
group_help: Position does not identify an animal. This group can contain different visitors.
group_dismiss: {count, plural, one {Dismiss remaining # photo} other {Dismiss remaining # photos}}
confidence_help: From 50% to 95%. Higher values reduce proposals but can miss animals. Applies to new motion photos only; bird detection and person privacy checks are unchanged.
group_remaining: Other photos in this group still need review.
beta_off_desc: Garden animals is a beta feature. Turn it on in Settings, Beta features, to collect and review non-bird visitors. Saved captures are kept while it is off.
automatic_bird: Bird suggested. Bird-only captures go to Dismissed; return this photo to review if the check is wrong.
automatic_non_animal: Blank scene or vehicle suggested. These captures go to Dismissed; return this photo to review if the check is wrong.
automatic_animal: Non-bird animal suggested. Check the photo and confirm animal presence yourself.
automatic_named: Confident animal. Confirmed and named automatically; dismiss the capture or discard the name if either is wrong.
identification_automatic: Named automatically. Discard the name if it is wrong.
automatic_uncertain: Uncertain result. This photo still needs your review.
automatic_unavailable: The automatic check was unavailable. This photo stays in Needs review; checks retry after five minutes while Garden is enabled.
automatic_overridden: Your review overrides this automatic result. This capture will not be checked again automatically.
model_download_in_settings: This model is not downloaded. Download it under Garden models in Settings → Beta features.

explorer.photo_expired: The photo has expired. The confirmed record is kept.
explorer.model_busy: The Garden model is busy with another photo. Try again shortly.
explorer.dismissed: Capture dismissed. Find it under Garden animals, Dismissed.
explorer.identification_box: Box: the crop the species model read.
explorer.review_presence: Needs review: check that an animal is in the photo.
explorer.review_species: Needs review: the species was suggested, not confirmed.
explorer.confirm_needs_photo: An animal can be confirmed only while its photo is shown.

explorer.blocked_sort: Garden captures show between visits only when visits are in time order.
explorer.blocked_ungrouped: Garden captures show between visits. Group captures into visits, or choose Garden animals to see them on their own.
explorer.blocked_selection: Garden captures are hidden while you select bird visits.
explorer.bird_filters_ignored: Species, Favourites, Hidden, Multiple species, Matching call and confidence order describe bird visits, so they are not applied to Garden captures.

explorer.no_cameras_desc: Turn Garden animals on for a camera, and its confirmed animals and captures waiting for review appear here.
explorer.empty_desc: Confirmed animals and captures waiting for review appear here. Dismissed captures are under Review, Dismissed.
explorer.empty_guest_desc: Animals confirmed on the Garden cameras appear here.
explorer.subjects_all_hint: Garden animals between the bird visits.

explorer.state_dismissed: Dismissed, not counted as an animal

explorer.identify_runs_on: New manual suggestion: SpeciesNet {variant} on {device}. The suggestion still needs your confirmation.
explorer.device_note: Used for species suggestions and photo checks. A device that is not available here fails instead of falling back to the CPU.

explorer.visit_heading: {count, plural, one {# capture in this visit} other {# captures in this visit}}
explorer.visit_help: Same camera and same animal, captures less than a minute apart, as bird visits are grouped. It can still be more than one animal.

explorer.capture_actions: Open a capture to review it on its own photo.

explorer.state_domestic: Named automatically as a domestic bird you keep

visit_dismiss_reload: Load this visit’s captures again before dismissing them together.

domestic_birds.suggestion: This looks like a domestic bird: {birds}. If you keep them, add them under Domestic birds you keep to record them as Garden animals, not wild birds.

automatic_animal_below_threshold: Animal detected, but its species score is below the naming threshold. It waits in Needs review: confirm it and pick a species, or dismiss it.
automatic_bird_camera: Bird, handled by bird detection on this camera. Moved to Dismissed; return this photo to review if it is not a bird.
automatic_wild_bird: Wild bird. Turn on birds for this camera to record it. Moved to Dismissed; return this photo to review if the check is wrong.
